title: Masterclass: How to Break Down a Whole Chicken into 8–10 Cuts
originalTitle: Masterclass: How to Break Down a Whole Chicken into 8–10 Cuts
ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil or softened herb butter (for roasting/searing the butchered cuts)
1 tbsp kosher salt & 1 tsp cracked black pepper
Aromatics for carcass stock: 1 onion, 1 carrot, 1 celery stalk, bay leaf, peppercorns
instructions: Remove the Wishbone: Slice inside the neck cavity along both sides of the wishbone and pull it out intact (makes carving the breasts effortless).

Remove Legs & Carve Chicken Oysters: Slice through the skin between the leg and breast, pop the thigh joint out of the socket, and cut along the backbone specifically scooping under the two prized 'chicken oysters' (sot-l'y-laisse) so they stay attached to the thighs. Separate drumsticks from thighs at the white fat line.

Remove Wings & Supreme the Breasts: Cut through the wing joints (or leave the drumette attached for an airline 'supreme' breast). Slice down one side of the keelbone (breastbone), following the ribcage with the tip of your knife to release two clean skin-on chicken breasts + tenderloins.
Roast the butchered cuts at 425°F (breasts 15–18 mins to 158°F; thighs/drumsticks 25–30 mins to 175°F) and simmer the remaining carcass with aromatics for homemade chicken stock.
